# Vendored libraries

Kept in the repo (not loaded from a CDN) so the board works when a CDN is slow or
blocked at the venue.

- `qrcode-generator-1.4.4/qrcode.js`: QR code generator, from the npm package
  `qrcode-generator@1.4.4`, unchanged. MIT licence (header of the file), by Kazuhiko
  Arase. Draws the QR codes of the view-only table and of the board itself (lib/qr.js).
